results.name: RMIT Research Stipend Scholarship
results.description: Provides living allowance for domestic and international higher degree by research students at RMIT. Covers up to 3 years for masters by research students.
results.eligibility: International and domestic students enrolled in research masters or PhD at RMIT with strong academic record
results.matchReason: Perfect institutional match as student is already at RMIT, meets GPA requirements, and is an international student studying at graduate level.

results.name: Australia Awards Scholarship
results.institution: Australian Government - Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
results.description: Prestigious scholarship for international students from developing countries including China to undertake postgraduate study in Australia. Covers tuition, living expenses, and return airfare.
results.eligibility: Citizens of participating countries including China, not holding Australian citizenship or permanent residency, returning to home country for at least 2 years
results.matchReason: Chinese nationals are eligible, covers full costs addressing financial need, and accepts graduate students with GPA above 3.0.

results.name: Destination Australia Scholarship
results.description: Supports domestic and international students to study in regional Australia. Aims to increase education opportunities in regional areas.
results.eligibility: International and domestic students commencing or continuing studies at participating regional institutions
results.matchReason: Open to international graduate students in Australia with some financial need, though RMIT Melbourne location may limit eligibility for regional focus.

results.name: Endeavour Postgraduate Leadership Award
results.description: Provides financial support for international students undertaking postgraduate study or research in Australia. Supports high-achieving students to study at Australian institutions.
results.eligibility: International students enrolled in masters or doctoral programs at Australian universities, not Australian citizens or permanent residents
results.matchReason: Specifically targets international postgraduate students in Australia with strong GPA matching exactly the 3.5 requirement.

results.name: RMIT International Excellence Scholarship
results.description: Tuition fee reduction for high-achieving international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs at RMIT. Automatically assessed upon application.
results.eligibility: International students with strong academic records applying for or enrolled in RMIT coursework programs
results.matchReason: Direct match for international RMIT graduate students with 3.5 GPA, automatically considered, and addresses partial financial need.

results.name: ASID Foundation Graduate Scholarship
results.institution: American Society of Interior Designers Foundation
results.description: Supports graduate students pursuing interior design education. Open to students enrolled in CIDA-accredited or substantially equivalent programs worldwide.
results.eligibility: Graduate students enrolled in interior design programs, demonstrated financial need, academic merit
results.matchReason: Specifically designed for graduate interior design students with demonstrated financial need, though US-based organization may favor domestic applicants.

results.name: China Scholarship Council - Australian University Partnership
results.description: Joint scholarship between CSC and Australian universities for Chinese nationals to pursue postgraduate research degrees. Covers tuition fees and living allowance.
results.eligibility: Chinese citizens with strong academic records, enrolled or applying for research masters or PhD at participating Australian universities including RMIT

results.name: Interior Designers Institute Global Scholarship
results.description: Annual scholarship for interior design students worldwide who demonstrate academic excellence and passion for the field. Open to undergraduate and graduate students.
results.eligibility: Enrolled interior design students at accredited institutions globally, portfolio submission required, minimum 3.0 GPA
results.matchReason: Accepts international graduate interior design students with qualifying GPA, though smaller award amount and competitive international pool.

results.name: RMIT Research Stipend Scholarship

results.eligibility: Enrolled in research masters or PhD at RMIT, minimum 3.0 GPA equivalent, international students eligible
results.matchReason: Perfect institutional match as current RMIT student with qualifying GPA, though competitive for research-focused programs.

results.name: Australia Awards Scholarship
results.description: Australian Government scholarships for international students from developing countries including China. Covers tuition, living expenses, and health insurance for masters degrees.
results.eligibility: Chinese nationals, masters students in Australia, demonstrated academic merit, commitment to development

results.name: Design Institute of Australia Student Scholarship
results.description: Annual scholarship supporting outstanding design students including interior design at Australian universities. Recognizes academic excellence and design portfolio quality.
results.eligibility: Enrolled in design program at Australian university, strong academic record, portfolio submission required
results.matchReason: Strong field-specific match for interior design masters student with qualifying GPA at Australian institution.

results.name: RMIT International Excellence Scholarship
results.description: Merit scholarships for high-achieving international students at RMIT across all programs. Partial tuition fee reduction based on academic performance.
results.eligibility: International students at RMIT, minimum 3.5 GPA equivalent, commencing or continuing postgraduate coursework
results.matchReason: Exact GPA match and current RMIT international student status makes this highly accessible and relevant.

results.name: Chinese Government Award for Outstanding Self-Financed Students Abroad
results.description: Awards Chinese nationals studying abroad who demonstrate excellent academic performance. Recognizes self-funded students pursuing advanced degrees internationally.
results.eligibility: Chinese citizens studying overseas, enrolled in masters or PhD, strong academic record, self-funded
results.matchReason: Specifically targets Chinese nationals pursuing masters abroad with strong academics, matching student's exact profile.

results.name: Women in Architecture and Design Scholarship
results.description: Supports women pursuing careers in architecture and related design fields including interior design. Awards based on academic merit and career commitment to design industry.
results.eligibility: Female students in architecture or design programs at Australian universities, demonstrated commitment to profession
results.matchReason: Field-specific scholarship for design students in Australia, though gender-specific eligibility may apply.

results.name: Victorian International Education Awards
results.description: Supports international students studying in Victoria including Melbourne-based institutions. Awards excellence in academic achievement and community contribution.
results.eligibility: International students enrolled in Victorian universities, demonstrated academic excellence and community engagement
results.matchReason: Geographic and international student status match as RMIT is Melbourne-based, though requires demonstrated community involvement.

results.name: Asian Development Bank-Japan Scholarship
results.description: Provides scholarships to students from ADB member countries including China for postgraduate studies at designated institutions. Covers tuition and living expenses for economics and related fields.
results.eligibility: Citizens of ADB member countries including China, masters students, good academic record, under 35 years old
results.matchReason: Matches nationality and study level, though RMIT may not be designated partner and design fields have lower priority than economics.

results.name: Monash Graduate Excellence Scholarship
results.description: Awarded to high-achieving domestic students commencing graduate research or coursework programs at Monash University. Recognizes academic excellence and supports students pursuing advanced studies.
results.eligibility: Domestic students (Australian citizens/permanent residents) enrolled in graduate programs at Monash with strong academic records
results.matchReason: Perfect institutional match as current Monash student pursuing graduate studies with qualifying GPA and Australian citizenship.

results.name: Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Stipend
results.description: Government-funded scholarship supporting domestic students undertaking research Masters or PhD programs. Covers living expenses and tuition fees for research degree candidates.
results.eligibility: Australian citizens, Australian permanent residents, or New Zealand citizens undertaking research Masters or PhD at Australian universities
results.matchReason: Strong match for Australian citizen at recognized university with qualifying GPA, particularly if pursuing research-based Masters in Economics.

results.name: Economic Society of Australia Postgraduate Scholarship
results.description: Supports outstanding Australian students pursuing postgraduate studies in economics. Aims to develop future leaders in economic policy and research.
results.eligibility: Australian citizens or permanent residents enrolled in postgraduate economics programs at Australian universities
results.matchReason: Direct field alignment with Economics Masters, meets nationality and academic requirements, and targets exact student demographic.

results.name: Monash Business School Graduate Scholarship
results.description: Supports domestic students enrolled in graduate programs within Monash Business School including economics, finance, and related disciplines. Awards based on academic merit and potential contribution to the field.
results.eligibility: Domestic students commencing graduate coursework programs in Monash Business School with minimum 70% undergraduate average
results.matchReason: Excellent fit for Economics graduate at Monash Business School with qualifying GPA and domestic student status.

results.name: Australian Federation of University Women - Victoria Postgraduate Bursary
results.description: Provides financial assistance to women undertaking postgraduate studies at Victorian universities. Considers academic merit alongside financial need and contribution to community.
results.eligibility: Female students enrolled in postgraduate programs at Victorian universities demonstrating financial need and academic achievement
results.source: Australian Federation of University Women Victoria
results.matchReason: Good match if student is female, studying in Victoria at Monash with demonstrated financial need and qualifying academics.

results.name: Reserve Bank of Australia Postgraduate Research Scholarship
results.description: Supports high-caliber students conducting postgraduate research in economics or related fields relevant to central banking. Offers networking opportunities with RBA economists.
results.eligibility: Australian or New Zealand citizens pursuing research higher degrees in economics, finance, or econometrics at Australian universities
results.matchReason: Strong alignment with Economics field, Australian nationality, and academic qualifications, especially valuable for research-focused programs.

results.name: Endeavour Postgraduate Leadership Award
results.description: Recognizes leadership potential and academic excellence among domestic postgraduate students. Supports coursework or research programs across all disciplines at Australian universities.
results.eligibility: Australian citizens undertaking postgraduate studies at recognized Australian institutions with demonstrated leadership and academic achievement
results.matchReason: Suitable match for Australian graduate student with strong academics, though may require demonstrated leadership activities for competitive application.

results.name: Walter and Dorothy Duncan Trust Postgraduate Scholarship
results.description: Assists financially disadvantaged Australian students of high academic merit pursuing postgraduate studies. Prioritizes students demonstrating both significant need and academic potential.
results.eligibility: Australian citizens with financial hardship enrolled in postgraduate programs at Australian universities with strong academic records
results.matchReason: Good fit combining merit and financial need criteria for Australian postgraduate student with qualifying GPA and demonstrated need.

results.name: Rhodes Scholarship
results.description: The world's most prestigious international scholarship programme, enabling outstanding students from around the world to study at Oxford. Covers all university and college fees, a personal stipend, and travel costs for postgraduate study in any field including STEM.
results.eligibility: Open to citizens of eligible countries, aged 18-27, with completed undergraduate degree and strong academic record

results.name: Clarendon Scholarship
results.description: Oxford's flagship scholarship scheme for graduate students, covering tuition and college fees plus a generous living stipend. Awards approximately 150 scholarships annually across all disciplines including engineering and sciences.
results.eligibility: All graduate applicants to Oxford are automatically considered; based on academic excellence and potential

results.name: Simon and June Li Undergraduate Scholarship
results.description: Supports undergraduate students from China and Hong Kong reading STEM subjects at Oxford. Provides annual awards to help with living costs throughout the degree programme.
results.eligibility: Chinese or Hong Kong nationals admitted to undergraduate STEM courses at Oxford with demonstrated financial need

results.name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
results.description: Designed for students from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their own country. Covers course fees, a grant for living costs, and one return airfare per year for undergraduates including those studying engineering and sciences.
results.eligibility: Students from low-income countries who have not previously studied at university level; must demonstrate financial need

results.name: Croucher Scholarships for Doctoral Study
results.description: Supports Hong Kong residents pursuing doctoral study in natural sciences, technology and medicine at Oxford. Provides full tuition coverage plus generous stipend for living expenses for the duration of DPhil study.
results.eligibility: Permanent residents of Hong Kong pursuing doctoral studies in natural sciences, engineering, technology or medicine

results.name: Oxford-Weidenfeld and Hoffmann Scholarships
results.description: Leadership scholarships for graduate students from transition and emerging economies to study at Oxford. Covers full tuition and living expenses with preference for candidates in STEM fields who demonstrate leadership potential.
results.eligibility: Students from Africa, Asia, Eastern Europe and Middle East with strong academic record and leadership experience

results.name: Goodger and Schorstein Research Scholarships
results.description: Supports graduate research students in Engineering Science at Oxford. Provides funding towards living expenses for DPhil candidates demonstrating exceptional research potential in engineering disciplines.
results.eligibility: Graduate students enrolled in DPhil programmes in Engineering Science at Oxford with strong research proposals

results.name: Chevening Scholarships
results.description: UK government's global scholarship programme enabling future leaders to study one-year master's degrees at Oxford and other UK universities. Covers tuition, living expenses, travel costs for any field including engineering and STEM subjects.
results.eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years work experience and strong leadership potential
results.source: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

results.name: Harvard University Presidential Scholars
results.description: Prestigious merit scholarship for exceptional graduate students across all Harvard schools. Covers full tuition and provides stipend for living expenses.
results.eligibility: Admitted graduate students with exceptional academic records and leadership potential

results.name: Harvard Graduate Prize Fellowship
results.description: Competitive fellowship for PhD students in humanities and social sciences. Provides full tuition remission plus annual stipend for up to five years.
results.eligibility: PhD applicants to GSAS programs in humanities and social sciences

results.name: Frank Knox Memorial Fellowship
results.description: Scholarship for graduate students from Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and United Kingdom. Covers tuition and living expenses for graduate study at Harvard.
results.eligibility: Citizens of Australia, Canada, New Zealand, or UK pursuing graduate degrees

results.name: Harvard Kennedy School Public Service Fellowship
results.description: Fellowship for mid-career professionals pursuing Master in Public Policy or Public Administration. Covers full tuition for students committed to public service careers.
results.eligibility: Demonstrated commitment to public service, minimum 3 years professional experience

results.name: Harvard Business School Fellowship
results.description: Need-based fellowship for MBA students demonstrating financial need. Covers partial to full tuition based on individual circumstances and merit.
results.eligibility: Admitted MBA students with demonstrated financial need

results.name: Radcliffe Institute Fellowship

results.eligibility: PhD candidates in dissertation stage or completed doctorate in any field

results.name: Harvard Medical School Dean's Diversity Scholarship
results.description: Scholarship for medical students from underrepresented backgrounds in medicine. Covers full tuition and provides additional support for research and professional development.
results.eligibility: Admitted MD students from underrepresented groups in medicine

results.name: Harvard Graduate School of Education Merit Fellowship
results.description: Merit-based fellowship for exceptional students pursuing master's or doctoral programs in education. Awards based on academic excellence and commitment to educational equity.

results.name: Federal Pell Grant
results.description: The Federal Pell Grant is the largest federal grant program offered to undergraduates with exceptional financial need who have not earned a bachelor's degree. Award amounts are determined by the FAFSA and cost of attendance.
results.eligibility: Undergraduate students with exceptional financial need who have not earned a bachelor's, graduate, or professional degree

results.name: Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant (FSEOG)
results.description: FSEOG provides additional grant funding to undergraduate students with exceptional financial need, prioritizing Pell Grant recipients. Funds are awarded by participating colleges on a first-come, first-served basis.
results.eligibility: Undergraduate students with exceptional financial need, priority given to Pell Grant recipients

results.name: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship
results.description: This scholarship supports high-achieving community college students with financial need who seek to complete their bachelor's degrees at four-year institutions. Recipients receive up to $55,000 per year along with academic advising and support.
results.eligibility: Community college students planning to transfer to a four-year institution with financial need and academic achievement

results.name: Horatio Alger National Scholarship
results.description: This scholarship assists high school students who have demonstrated integrity, perseverance in overcoming adversity, and financial need. Recipients must be involved in co-curricular and community activities and demonstrate strong academic performance.
results.eligibility: U.S. high school seniors with critical financial need (adjusted gross income under $55,000) who have overcome significant adversity

results.name: QuestBridge National College Match
results.description: QuestBridge connects high-achieving, low-income students with full four-year scholarships to 50+ top colleges and universities. Matched students receive comprehensive financial aid packages covering tuition, room, board, books, and travel expenses.
results.eligibility: High school seniors from low-income backgrounds (typically under $65,000 family income) with outstanding academic achievement

results.name: Burger King Scholars Program
results.description: This program awards scholarships to high school seniors, Burger King employees, and their families who demonstrate financial need and academic achievement. Awards range from $1,000 to $50,000 based on demonstrated need and merit.

results.name: Coca-Cola First Generation Scholarship
results.description: This scholarship supports first-generation college students with financial need who demonstrate leadership and commitment to community service. The program provides renewable awards for up to four years of undergraduate study.
